subject: Commercial kickoff: MSA + Order Form — exhibit ownership & technical ops questions
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@alturilabs.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@alturilabs.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form kickoff — exhibits and operational questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. Alturi is excited to move forward — we want to get a clean MSA + Order Form in place before the pilot starts in June. Before we hand over the redlines, a few things the legal and ops teams asked that we'd like to get clarified up front so we can align drafting: 

- Exhibit ownership: which exhibits (Exhibit A pricing, Exhibit C SOW, Exhibit D IP) will be customer-provided vs Redwood-provided templates? Our legal prefers drafting the IP exhibit.
- Billing cadence & invoicing contact: do you require a PO? Who should we list as billing contact?
- Data residency / ops: for the Dedicated pilot we'll likely need region-specific deployment notes — do you have a standard residency exhibit or appendix?
- Security evidence: can you share an SOC 2 summary and the retention period for audit logs? Our security team will want the evidence link before signing.

Attached: AL_MSA_Draft_Redline_v1.docx (our initial redline), Alturi_Party_Sheet.xlsx (party + billing info).

If you can point us to the right templates and owners internally we will consolidate edits and return an updated redline by Friday.

Best,
Priya Rao
Legal Counsel
Alturi Labs

Attachments: AL_MSA_Draft_Redline_v1.docx (docx, 312KB); Alturi_Party_Sheet.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

From: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@alturilabs.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — exhibits and operational questions

Hi Priya — really appreciate the clear list and the redline. High-level answers below and next steps.

Quick answers:
- Exhibits: Redwood supplies standard templates for Exhibit A (pricing) and Exhibit C (SOW) by default; customers can propose alternative language for IP/Exhibit D and we typically review. If Alturi prefers to draft Exhibit D, please mark it as customer-provided in the party sheet and we will incorporate.
- Billing: we accept POs; billing contact should be the AP contact in your party sheet (we received the spreadsheet). Kimberly will confirm invoicing cadence and EDI/PO process.
- Data residency: we have a residency appendix for Dedicated/private deployments. That appendix contains region mapping and data-at-rest controls — I will attach the template.
- Security evidence: we can share our SOC 2 snapshot (summary) and a pointer to the evidence bundle (read-only link). Retention for audit logs is 90 days by default; we can discuss extension options for enterprise customers.

Next steps:
1) I am looping in Kimberly Park (billing/ops) and Marissa Cole (contracts intake) to lead internal review.
2) Kimberly will confirm invoicing cadence and PO details.
3) Marissa will intake the redline and run it against our standard templates; expect a first-pass alignment email within 24 business hours.
4) We'll upload the SOC 2 summary + residency appendix to a secure share and send you the link.

If you'd like a short triage call (15 minutes) to walk through the redline hotspots, we can do that today 3:30pm PT.

Thanks,
Sojin Lee
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Snapshot_v2025Q1.pdf (pdf, 220KB); Residency_Appendix_Template.docx (docx, 55KB)

We can do the 3:30pm PT triage call — Priya and our infra lead (Tom Reed) will join.
